correctness.rationale: Exact permutation dot-product and parity separation inequalities give disjoint vertex caps; tridiagonal root Gram determinants and Cayley zonotope volume yield the complete (n−1)-volume formula. The foot of each cut has a positive convex decomposition with explicitly checked quadratic coefficients, proving sharp Hausdorff distance and uniqueness. Full finite checker independently verified n=3..6 hull volumes, exact weights n=3..7 and width optimization; exhaustive finite checks do not replace arbitrary-n proof.

value.rationale: A natural half-vertex parity deletion of a canonical Euclidean orbit polytope has two sharply distinct quantitative stability scales: Hausdorff deficit of order n^(-3/2) but relative volume deficit exactly 1/(2n^(n−3)). The positive all-neighbor closest-point certificate is a usable robustness witness and completes a meaningful infinite-family metric classification, beyond a table or a trivial special-case reparametrization.
